bioconda.name: gzrt
bioconda.summary: Unofficial build of the gzip Recovery Toolkit aka gzrecover.
bioconda.description:
gzrecover is a program that will attempt to extract any readable data
out of a gzip file that has been corrupted.

commands: dd if=/dev/zero of=test.gz bs=1 count=1 seek=5 conv=notrunc
